limitations: Twelve single-vehicle observations: one user-opened VINwiki result, one independently observed advert-to-lookup route, and ten user-supplied registration/VIN pairs. None corroborates another observation of the same derivative.

The eight requested additional derivatives now have user-reported candidates. G60/G61 i5 exact engine/drive remains unconfirmed. UK/RHD/import context and exact era semantics remain open for all candidates; no profile is activated.

Observed UK-registered G05 X5 xDrive50e uses WBA and F95 X5 M Competition uses WBS. These samples do not fill the separate five-WMI requirement for 5UX/5YM fixtures/population, and North American WMI/descriptor mappings must not be substituted for them.

Position-ten zero is a literal observation, not decoded model/build year or a universal BMW convention. The eight latest samples are user-described as 2026 models; the F95 manufacture-in-2026 statement is user-reported AutoTrader evidence, not an independent date verification.

Observed position-eleven characters 7/C/F/9/5/8 can be compared with the separate plant dictionary; exact UK model/era allocation remains unverified. In particular, the WBA G42 observation uses 8, so Mexican assembly must not be treated as proof of a 3MW WMI.
Serial shapes include both one letter plus five digits and six digits; do not impose one shape across all model profiles.
Twelve checksum matches do not establish the rule for all UK vehicles or historical generations, nor do they authenticate a VIN or its derivative.
The M Sport 330e sample is suitable for the first pass; retain trim separately from the reusable model profile and do not infer that trim can never affect type coding.
No VINwiki API, automated access terms, bulk throughput or specification coverage proved.
profileRefinement: Match generation, derivative, drive/transmission and steering/market context; record imports, mismatches and unknowns.
Seek a second distinct consistent example; preserve observational versus manufacturer-verified confidence.
Resolve required type/year/plant/format semantics before enabling a bounded generator profile.
Generate serials independently; never mutate an observed identity.
